+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "layout", RocmOctaveAttentionBackend.supported_kv_cache_layouts()
+)
+def test_kernels_follow_declared_cache_layouts(layout):
+    """Store, decode and prefill on the cache view vLLM allocates for each
+    declared layout match a contiguous cache bit for bit. Two KV heads, so the
+    head and token strides differ between layouts."""
+    torch.manual_seed(4)
+    dev, cache_dtype = "cuda", "octave_k3v3"
+    fmt, hkv, group, nblk = _format(cache_dtype), 2, 6, 80
+    signs = sq.sign_bits(HEAD).to(dev)
+    sq.register_rope_dim(HEAD, ROPE)
+    spec = RocmOctaveAttentionBackend.customize_spec(
+        FullAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=BLOCK,
+            num_kv_heads=hkv,
+            head_size=HEAD,
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            kv_quant_mode=get_kv_quant_mode(cache_dtype),
+        )
+    )
+    raw = torch.zeros(nblk * spec.page_size_bytes, dtype=torch.int8, device=dev)
+    cache = dense_kv_cache_views(raw, spec, nblk, 1, layout)[0]
+    dense = torch.zeros(nblk, hkv, BLOCK, fmt.slot_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=dev)
+    assert cache.shape == dense.shape and cache.dtype == dense.dtype
+
+    seq_lens, query_lens = [700, 300], [100, 300]
+    max_blocks = max(math.ceil(n / BLOCK) for n in seq_lens)
+    block_table = torch.zeros(len(seq_lens), max_blocks, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    free, used, ks, vs = torch.randperm(nblk, device=dev), 0, [], []
+    for i, n in enumerate(seq_lens):
+        nb = math.ceil(n / BLOCK)
+        block_table[i, :nb] = free[used : used + nb].int()
+        used += nb
+        ks.append(torch.randn(n, hkv, HEAD, device=dev).half())
+        vs.append(torch.randn(n, hkv, HEAD, device=dev).half())
+        for c in (cache, dense):
+            _fill(c, block_table[i, :nb], ks[i], vs[i], signs, signs, fmt)
+    assert torch.equal(cache, dense)
+
+    q_to_req = torch.arange(len(seq_lens), dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    q_to_klen = torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    q = torch.randn(len(seq_lens), hkv * group, HEAD, device=dev).half()
+    for use_wmma in (True, False):
+        out, ref = (
+            _decode(c, q, block_table, q_to_req, q_to_klen, signs, fmt, use_wmma)
+            for c in (cache, dense)
+        )
+        assert out.abs().sum() > 0
+        assert torch.equal(out, ref)
+
+    qsl = torch.tensor([0, *query_lens], device=dev).cumsum(0).int()
+    q = torch.randn(int(qsl[-1]), hkv * group, HEAD, device=dev).half()
+    ctx = [n - m for n, m in zip(seq_lens, query_lens)]
+    k = torch.cat([x[c:] for x, c in zip(ks, ctx)])
+    v = torch.cat([x[c:] for x, c in zip(vs, ctx)])
+    out, ref = (
+        _prefill(c, q, k, v, block_table, qsl, q_to_klen, signs, fmt)
+        for c in (cache, dense)
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(out, ref)

+def _window_tables(entries, hkv, dev):

+        torch.full((entries,), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev),
+        torch.zeros(entries, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev),
+    )

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("window", ["off", "on", "evicted"])
+def test_sparse_decode_matches_reference(cache_dtype, hkv, group, window):
+    """Sparse (top-k) decode as qwen4_exp QSA runs it: each query reads the
+    logical positions in its index row, -1 entries are holes. With the window
+    on, the first 4 and the last 64 positions come from the fp16 tables;
+    an entry whose tag was overwritten falls back to the packed cache."""
+    torch.manual_seed(4)
+    dev, fmt = "cuda", _format(cache_dtype)
+    signs = sq.sign_bits(HEAD).to(dev)
+    lens, max_blocks, nblk = [1500, 2600, 777], 192, 1024
+    cache = torch.zeros(nblk, hkv, BLOCK, fmt.slot_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=dev)
+    block_table = (
+        torch.randperm(nblk, device=dev)[: len(lens) * max_blocks]
+        .view(len(lens), max_blocks)
+        .int()
+    )
+    wtab, wtags, wlocks = _window_tables(4096, hkv, dev)
+    stab, stags, slocks = _window_tables(256, hkv, dev)
+    ks, vs = [], []
+    for r, n in enumerate(lens):
+        k = torch.randn(n, hkv, HEAD, device=dev).half()
+        v = torch.randn_like(k)
+        pos = torch.arange(n, device=dev)
+        slots = block_table[r, pos // BLOCK].long() * BLOCK + pos % BLOCK
+        torch.ops._C.octave_cache_store(
+            k, v, cache, slots, signs, signs, fmt.kernel_code
+        )
+        torch.ops._C.octave_window_store(
+            k, v, slots, pos.int(), wtab, wtags, wlocks, stab, stags, slocks
+        )
+        ks.append(k)
+        vs.append(v)
+    if window == "evicted":
+        wtags[::2] = -7
+        stags[::2] = -7
+
+    q_to_req = torch.tensor([0, 1, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2], dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    num_q, topk = q_to_req.numel(), 512
+    qpos = torch.tensor(
+        [lens[r] - 1 - 37 * i for i, r in enumerate(q_to_req.tolist())],
+        dtype=torch.int32,
+        device=dev,
+    )
+    indices = torch.full((num_q, topk), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    for i in range(num_q):
+        n = int(qpos[i]) + 1
+        cand = torch.cat(
+            [
+                torch.arange(max(0, n - 80), n, device=dev),
+                torch.arange(4, device=dev),
+                torch.randperm(n, device=dev)[:300],
+            ]
+        ).unique()
+        indices[i, : cand.numel()] = cand.int()
+        indices[i] = indices[i][torch.randperm(topk, device=dev)]
+
+    q = torch.randn(num_q, hkv * group, HEAD, device=dev).half()
+    out = torch.empty_like(q)
+    mid = torch.empty(num_q, hkv * group, 64, HEAD + 2, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
+    scale = HEAD**-0.5
+    window_args = () if window == "off" else (qpos, wtab, wtags, stab, stags)
+    torch.ops._C.octave_decode_sparse(
+        out,
+        q,
+        cache,
+        block_table,
+        q_to_req,
+        indices,
+        mid,
+        signs,
+        signs,
+        scale,
+        64,
+        fmt.kernel_code,
+        *window_args,
+    )
+
+    ref = torch.zeros(num_q, hkv * group, HEAD, device=dev)
+    for i in range(num_q):
+        r, p = int(q_to_req[i]), int(qpos[i])
+        sel = indices[i][indices[i] >= 0].long()
+        blocks = block_table[r, sel // BLOCK].long()
+        k, v = sq.reference_dequantize(cache[blocks, :, sel % BLOCK], fmt)
+        if window != "off":
+            slot = blocks * BLOCK + sel % BLOCK
+            exact = ((p - sel) < 64) & (wtags[slot % 4096].long() == slot)
+            exact |= (sel < 4) & (stags[slot % 256].long() == slot)
+            k[exact] = ks[r][sel[exact]].float()
+            v[exact] = vs[r][sel[exact]].float()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Octave attention backend for AMD GPUs (native kernels: HIP or FlyDSL).
+
+KV cache format and reference: ``vllm/v1/attention/ops/rocm_octave.py``.
+Kernels: ``csrc/attention/octave_attn.cu`` and the per-architecture tiers in
+``_kernel_tier``; RDNA3 and CDNA3, validated on gfx1100 and gfx942. See
+``docs/design/rocm_octave.md``.
+
+Decode, MTP verification and short continuation chunks (every request with
+at most ``_DECODE_MAX_QUERY_LEN`` query tokens) run the split-KV decode
+kernel over the packed cache; consecutive query tokens of one request share
+each K/V read. Longer prefills run the prefill kernel, which reads the cached
+prefix from the packed cache and the current chunk's K/V unquantized.
+"""
+
+import contextlib
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from typing import ClassVar
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.config.cache import CacheDType
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.platforms.interface import DeviceCapability
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import (
+    AttentionBackend,
+    AttentionCGSupport,
+    AttentionImpl,
+    AttentionLayer,
+    AttentionMetadataBuilder,
+    AttentionType,
+    CommonAttentionMetadata,
+    MultipleOf,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import split_decodes_and_prefills
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops import rocm_octave as sq
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import AttentionSpec, KVCacheSpec
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_layout import KVCacheLayout
+from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import (
+    current_workspace_manager,
+    is_workspace_manager_initialized,
+)
+
+
+# Native kernel tier per architecture family; any other family is rejected at
+# selection (supports_compute_capability) until it is validated.
+def _kernel_tier() -> str:
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version, get_rdna_version
+
+    if get_rdna_version() == 3:
+        return "wmma"
+    if get_cdna_version() == 3:
+        return "mfma"
+    raise NotImplementedError(
+        "ROCM_OCTAVE supports RDNA3 and CDNA3 only; "
+        "see the architecture contract in docs/design/rocm_octave.md"
+    )
+
+
+_DECODE_MAX_QUERY_LEN = 128
+_KERNEL_HEAD_SIZE = 256
+_KERNEL_ROPE_DIM = 64
+
+
+def _mid_o_shape(
+    num_q: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    max_splits: int,
+    capture_size: int,
+    split_cap: int | None = None,
+) -> tuple[tuple[int, int, int, int], int]:
+    """Split-KV partials for num_q queries: every split up to the cudagraph
+    capture size, fewer splits past it so the buffer never outgrows that.
+    With split_cap, small batches spend the same buffer on up to split_cap
+    splits (a wide GPU needs them to fill its CUs with one query)."""
+    budget = capture_size * max_splits
+    splits = max_splits if split_cap is None else min(split_cap, budget // num_q)
+    if num_q > capture_size:
+        splits = max(1, min(max_splits, budget // num_q))
+    return (num_q, num_heads, splits, _KERNEL_HEAD_SIZE + 2), splits
+
+
+def _max_capture_size(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> int:
+    return vllm_config.compilation_config.max_cudagraph_capture_size or 4
+
+
+class RocmOctaveAttentionBackend(AttentionBackend):
+    accept_output_buffer: bool = True
+    forward_includes_kv_cache_update: bool = False
+
+    supported_dtypes: ClassVar[list[torch.dtype]] = [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16]
+    supported_kv_cache_dtypes: ClassVar[list[CacheDType]] = [
+        "octave_k3v4",
+        "octave_k3v3",
+        "octave_k3v3_compact",
+    ]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_name() -> str:
+        return "ROCM_OCTAVE"
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_impl_cls() -> type["RocmOctaveAttentionImpl"]:
+        return RocmOctaveAttentionImpl
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_builder_cls() -> type["RocmOctaveMetadataBuilder"]:
+        return RocmOctaveMetadataBuilder
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_supported_kernel_block_sizes(
+        kv_cache_spec: "KVCacheSpec | None" = None,
+    ) -> list[int | MultipleOf]:
+        return [MultipleOf(16)]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def supports_compute_capability(cls, capability: DeviceCapability) -> bool:
+        from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version, get_rdna_version
+
+        # DeviceCapability is unreliable on ROCm; use the gcnArchName.
+        return current_platform.is_rocm() and (
+            get_rdna_version() == 3 or get_cdna_version() == 3
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_supported_head_sizes(cls) -> list[int]:
+        return [_KERNEL_HEAD_SIZE]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def supports_attn_type(cls, attn_type: str) -> bool:
+        return attn_type == AttentionType.DECODER
+
+    @classmethod
+    def supported_kv_cache_layouts(cls) -> tuple[KVCacheLayout, ...]:
+        # The kernels take block/head/token strides; the slot is contiguous.
+        # The MFMA decode loads 16 consecutive tokens of a head as one tile.
+        if current_platform.is_rocm():
+            from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+            if get_cdna_version() == 3:
+                return (KVCacheLayout.LBHNC,)
+        return (KVCacheLayout.LBHNC, KVCacheLayout.LBNHC)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def customize_spec(cls, spec: AttentionSpec) -> AttentionSpec:
+        """One packed K+V slot per (token, KV head)."""
+        if spec.state_content_bytes is not None or not spec.kv_quant_mode.is_octave:
+            return spec
+        fmt = sq.OctaveFormat.from_cache_dtype(
+            spec.kv_quant_mode.name.lower(),
+            spec.head_size,
+            sq.registered_rope_dim(spec.head_size),
+        )
+        return replace(spec, state_content_bytes=fmt.slot_bytes)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class RocmOctaveMetadata:
+    num_actual_tokens: int
+    max_query_len: int
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor
+    # Decode requests (one query token) come first in the batch.
+    num_decodes: int
+    num_decode_tokens: int
+    # Per query token: its request and its causal K length (0 for padding).
+    q_to_req: torch.Tensor
+    q_to_klen: torch.Tensor

+"""Octave KV-cache format: layout, rotations and a PyTorch reference.
+
+Each (token, KV head) is stored in one byte slot. V is always quantized
+whole; K has two layouts:
+
+* Block K (``octave_k3v4``, ``octave_k3v3``): random sign flips plus a
+  Walsh-Hadamard transform over each 64-dim block. The RoPE blocks get 4-bit
+  codes, the NoPE blocks 3-bit codes, and every block has its own scale.
+* Compact K (``octave_k3v3_compact``): sign flips plus one Hadamard transform
+  over all dims, 3-bit codes, one scale. Spreading the RoPE dims over the
+  whole head lets them share the 3-bit budget.
+* V: sign flips plus one Hadamard transform over all dims, ``v_bits`` codes.
+
+The rotated coordinates are close to Gaussian, so each code indexes a
+Lloyd-Max codebook for N(0, 1), stored as int8 (``LUT``): a code ``c`` of a
+block with scale ``s`` stands for ``LUT[c] * s / LUT_ONE``. The scale makes
+``x . x_hat = |x|^2``: a least-squares fit would shrink every reconstructed
+vector, which flattens the softmax and scales down the attention output.
+Everything is computed on the fly; there is no calibration.
+
+Scores are computed in the rotated space (the query is rotated like K) and
+the attention output is rotated back once per query head.
+
+Slot layout (bytes)::
+
+    [k_rope codes][k_nope codes][v codes][fp16 scales][pad to 8]
+
+Compact K has no 4-bit part and pads to 4 bytes.
+
+4-bit codes: each little-endian uint32 covers 8 dims; byte j holds dim j in
+its low nibble and dim j + 4 in its high nibble, so ``w & 0x0F0F0F0F`` and
+``(w >> 4) & 0x0F0F0F0F`` give dims 0..3 and 4..7 as bytes.
+
+3-bit codes: a 2-bit plane (uint32 per 16 dims; ``(w >> 2i) & 0x03030303``
+gives dims 4i..4i+3) followed by a 1-bit plane (uint32 per 32 dims;
+``(w >> i) & 0x01010101`` gives dims 4i..4i+3). code = lo + 4 * hi.
+
+Scales (fp16): one per 64-dim K block (one in total for compact K), then V.
+"""

+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass

+HADAMARD_BLOCK = 64
+_SIGN_SEED = 0x5E17

+NOPE_BITS = 3

+    3: (-127, -79, -45, -14, 14, 45, 79, 127),
+    4: (-126, -95, -74, -58, -43, -30, -18, -6, 6, 18, 30, 43, 58, 74, 95, 126),

+    lut = _lut(bits, str(x.device))
+    ss = x.pow(2).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+    rms = (ss / x.shape[-1]).sqrt().clamp_min(1e-12)
+    y = x / rms * LUT_MULT[bits]
+    codes = torch.bucketize(y, (lut[1:] + lut[:-1]) / 2)
+    dot = (x * lut[codes]).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+    scale = torch.where(dot > 0, ss / dot.clamp_min(1e-30), 0.0) * LUT_ONE
+    return codes.to(torch.uint8), scale
+
+
+def _pack(codes: torch.Tensor, bits: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """codes: (..., n) uint8 -> (..., n * bits / 8) uint8, layout above."""
+    c = codes.to(torch.int64)
+    if bits == 4:
+        g = c.view(*c.shape[:-1], -1, 2, 4)  # (word, half, byte)
+        b = g[..., 0, :] | (g[..., 1, :] << 4)
+        return b.reshape(*c.shape[:-1], -1).to(torch.uint8)
+    lo = (c & 3).view(*c.shape[:-1], -1, 4, 4)  # (word, i, byte)
+    lo_b = (lo << (2 * torch.arange(4, device=c.device)).view(4, 1)).sum(-2)
+    hi = (c >> 2).view(*c.shape[:-1], -1, 8, 4)
+    hi_b = (hi << torch.arange(8, device=c.device).view(8, 1)).sum(-2)
+    return torch.cat(
+        (lo_b.reshape(*c.shape[:-1], -1), hi_b.reshape(*c.shape[:-1], -1)), -1
+    ).to(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _unpack(packed: torch.Tensor, n: int, bits: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    p = packed.to(torch.int64)
+    if bits == 4:
+        g = p.view(*p.shape[:-1], -1, 4)
+        c = torch.stack((g & 15, g >> 4), dim=-2)
+        return c.reshape(*p.shape[:-1], n)
+    lo_bytes = n // 4
+    lo = p[..., :lo_bytes].view(*p.shape[:-1], -1, 1, 4)
+    lo = (lo >> (2 * torch.arange(4, device=p.device)).view(4, 1)) & 3
+    hi = p[..., lo_bytes:].view(*p.shape[:-1], -1, 1, 4)
+    hi = (hi >> torch.arange(8, device=p.device).view(8, 1)) & 1
+    return lo.reshape(*p.shape[:-1], n) + 4 * hi.reshape(*p.shape[:-1], n)
+
+
+def reference_quantize(
+    key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor, fmt: OctaveFormat
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """(T, H, D) K and V -> (T, H, slot_bytes) uint8 slots."""
+    t, h, d = key.shape
+    r, dev = fmt.rope_dim, key.device
+    out = torch.zeros(t, h, fmt.slot_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=dev)
+    nkb = fmt.num_k_blocks
+
+    if fmt.compact:
+        k = rotate(key, signs(d, str(dev)), d)
+        k_codes, k_scale = _quantize_lut(k, NOPE_BITS)
+        out[..., : fmt.off_v] = _pack(k_codes, NOPE_BITS)
+    else:
+        k = rotate(key, signs(d, str(dev))).view(t, h, nkb, HADAMARD_BLOCK)
+        nr = fmt.num_rope_blocks
+        kr_codes, kr_scale = _quantize_lut(k[:, :, :nr], ROPE_BITS)
+        kn_codes, kn_scale = _quantize_lut(k[:, :, nr:], NOPE_BITS)
+        out[..., : fmt.off_k_nope] = _pack(kr_codes.view(t, h, r), ROPE_BITS)
+        out[..., fmt.off_k_nope : fmt.off_v] = _pack(
+            kn_codes.view(t, h, fmt.nope_dim), NOPE_BITS
+        )
+        k_scale = torch.cat((kr_scale[..., 0], kn_scale[..., 0]), -1)
+
+    vr = rotate(value, signs(d, str(dev)), v_block(d))
+    v_codes, v_scale = _quantize_lut(vr, fmt.v_bits)
+    out[..., fmt.off_v : fmt.off_scales] = _pack(v_codes, fmt.v_bits)
+
+    scales = torch.cat((k_scale, v_scale), -1)
+    sc = scales.to(torch.float16).view(torch.uint8).view(t, h, -1)
+    out[..., fmt.off_scales : fmt.off_scales + sc.shape[-1]] = sc
+    return out
+
+
+def reference_dequantize(
+    slots: torch.Tensor, fmt: OctaveFormat, rotated: bool = False
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """(T, H, slot) slots -> fp32 K and V of shape (T, H, D).
+
+    With ``rotated=True`` K and V stay in the rotated space, which is what
+    the kernels consume.
+    """
+    t, h, _ = slots.shape
+    r, d, dev = fmt.rope_dim, fmt.head_size, slots.device
+    sc = (
+        slots[..., fmt.off_scales : fmt.off_scales + 2 * fmt.num_scales]
+        .contiguous()
+        .view(torch.float16)
+        .float()
+        / LUT_ONE
+    )
+    if fmt.compact:
+        k = _unpack(slots[..., : fmt.off_v], d, NOPE_BITS)
+        k = _lut(NOPE_BITS, str(dev))[k] * sc[..., :1]
+    else:
+        kr = _unpack(slots[..., : fmt.off_k_nope], r, ROPE_BITS)
+        kn = _unpack(slots[..., fmt.off_k_nope : fmt.off_v], fmt.nope_dim, NOPE_BITS)
+        k = torch.cat(
+            (_lut(ROPE_BITS, str(dev))[kr], _lut(NOPE_BITS, str(dev))[kn]), -1
+        ).view(t, h, fmt.num_k_blocks, HADAMARD_BLOCK)
+        k = (k * sc[..., : fmt.num_k_blocks, None]).view(t, h, d)
+
+    v = _unpack(slots[..., fmt.off_v : fmt.off_scales], d, fmt.v_bits)
+    v = _lut(fmt.v_bits, str(dev))[v] * sc[..., -1:]
+    if not rotated:
+        k = unrotate(k, signs(d, str(dev)), fmt.k_rotation_block)
+        v = unrotate(v, signs(d, str(dev)), v_block(d))
+    return k, v
+
+
+def reference_attention(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    cache: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    q_to_req: torch.Tensor,
+    q_to_klen: torch.Tensor,
+    fmt: OctaveFormat,
+    scale: float,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Per-query-token attention over a Octave paged cache.
+
+    query: (Q, Hq, D). cache: (num_blocks, Hkv, block_size, slot) uint8.
+    Query token i attends to the first ``q_to_klen[i]`` tokens of request
+    ``q_to_req[i]``.
+    """
+    num_q, hq, d = query.shape
+    _, hkv, block_size, _ = cache.shape
+    group = hq // hkv
+    out = torch.zeros(num_q, hq, d, dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device)
+    for i in range(num_q):
+        klen = int(q_to_klen[i])
+        if klen <= 0:
+            continue
+        req = int(q_to_req[i])
+        pos = torch.arange(klen, device=cache.device)
+        blocks = block_table[req, pos // block_size].long()
+        slots = cache[blocks, :, pos % block_size]  # (klen, Hkv, slot)
+        k, v = reference_dequantize(slots, fmt)
+        k = k.repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+        v = v.repeat_interleave(group, dim=1)
+        s = torch.einsum("hd,thd->ht", query[i].float(), k) * scale
+        p = torch.softmax(s, dim=-1)
+        out[i] = torch.einsum("ht,thd->hd", p, v)
+    return out

+def _serve_one(handler):
+    """Fake ``IpcModelLoader._connect``: serve each request on a thread and
+    close the accepted connection afterwards, like ``serve_forever``.
+
+    Returns the fake and the list of server threads it started.
+    """
+    import socket
+
+    server_threads: list[threading.Thread] = []
+
+    def connect(timeout: float) -> socket.socket:
+        client, connection = socket.socketpair()
+
+        def serve() -> None:
+            with connection:
+                handler(connection)
+
+        server_thread = threading.Thread(target=serve, daemon=True)
+        server_thread.start()
+        server_threads.append(server_thread)
+        return client
+
+    return connect, server_threads
+
+

+    """A zero-copy engine's watch connection closes exactly when the daemon
+    that served it exits; watches of exited engines are pruned."""

+    from vllm.config import LoadConfig
+    from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_cache import daemon, ipc_loader
+
+    server = object.__new__(daemon.WeightCacheDaemon)
+    server._watchers = []
+    connect, server_threads = _serve_one(server._handle_connection)
+    load_config = LoadConfig(
+        load_format="ipc_cache",
+        model_loader_extra_config={"socket_path": "/unused/daemon.sock"},
+    )
+    loaders = [ipc_loader.IpcModelLoader(load_config) for _ in range(2)]
+    threads = []
+    for loader in loaders:
+        monkeypatch.setattr(loader, "_connect", connect)
+        thread = loader._watch_daemon()
+        assert thread is not None
+        threads.append(thread)
+    for server_thread in server_threads:
+        server_thread.join(timeout=5)
+    # The second watch prunes nothing while the first engine is alive.
+    assert len(server._watchers) == 2
+    threads[0].join(timeout=0.2)
+    assert threads[0].is_alive() and not loaders[0].daemon_lost.is_set()
+

+    for watcher in server._watchers:

-  (`--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true,"use_thp":true}'`) and these per-point limits:

-  |---|---|---|---|
-  | 1, 4 | 8 | 4096 | 4092 |
-  | 8, 16 | 16, 32 | 8192 | 8190 |
-  | 32, 128 | 128, 256 | 8192 | 8190 |
-
-  Every TP4 point captures piecewise graphs at the DSpark verification multiples
-  `[6,12,18,24,30,36,48,60,72,96,120,144,192,240,288,384,480,576,768,1020,1536,2046,3072,4092]`,
-  extended with `6144,8190` from c8. From c16 it also captures decode-replay graphs separately,
-  with the same `decoder_replay_cudagraph_capture_sizes` as DEP4 below.
-
-  **TP2** at concurrency 1 runs the TP4 c1 settings on two GPUs (`--max-num-seqs 8`,
-  `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`, capture to 4092).
-
-  **DEP2** (TP1 x DP2 with expert parallelism) serves concurrency 8 to 32 with
-  `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`. `--max-num-seqs` is per DP rank: 16 at c8 and c16 and 32 at
-  c24 and c32. At c8 and c16 graph capture stops at 576 tokens
-  (`--max-cudagraph-capture-size 576`) and `--prefill-schedule-interval` stays at the vLLM
-  default of 1, while c24 and c32 extend piecewise graphs to 4096 tokens and set
-  `--prefill-schedule-interval 64`.
-
-  **DEP4** (TP1 x DP4) serves concurrency 96 and 128 with `--max-num-batched-tokens 8192` and
-  `--max-cudagraph-capture-size 8190`. `--max-num-seqs` is 96 at c96 and 128 at c128, and
-  `--prefill-schedule-interval` is 48 at both. Decode-replay graphs are captured separately:
-
-  ```
-  --compilation-config '{"mode":"VLLM_COMPILE","cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE","cudagraph_capture_sizes":[6,12,18,24,30,36,48,60,72,96,120,144,192,240,288,384,480,576,768,1020,1536,2046,3072,4092,6144,8190],"decoder_replay_cudagraph_capture_sizes":[6,12,18,24,30,36,48,60,72,96,120,144,192,240,288,384,480,576,768,1020,1536,2048,2304,2560,2816,3072,3328,3584,3840,4096]}'
-  ```
-
-  **DEP2 with host KV** at c64 and c128 adds vLLM's native CPU KV offloading with
-  `--kv-offloading-backend native --kv-offloading-size 32` (GiB per DP rank, 64 GiB per
-  server), `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.955` and `--max-num-seqs 48`. `--max-num-seqs` is per
-  DP rank, so the server runs up to 96 sequences: nothing queues at c64, and about 32 clients
-  wait at c128. It keeps `--prefill-schedule-interval` at 1 and captures graphs only up to
-  576 tokens (`--max-cudagraph-capture-size 576`), as DEP2 does at c8 and c16.
+  The InferenceX AgentX lanes that run as one server are presets, each with the lane's
+  concurrency points (see the **Presets** tab):
 
-  **Router.** DEP2 and DEP4 sit behind vLLM Router 0.1.14, which fronts the DP ranks of the
-  single server:
+  - **B200**: **AgentX TP** (TP4 for concurrency 1 to 128, TP2 at 1) and **AgentX DEP**
+    (DEP2, DEP2 with a host KV tier, and DEP4), the defaults on B200
+    ([InferenceX #3837](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3837)).
+  - **B300**: **AgentX TP4** and **AgentX DEP2** on the specialized decode image
+    ([InferenceX #4332](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4332)).
 
-  ```
-  vllm-router --policy consistent_hash --request-timeout-secs 14400 --disable-retries \
-    --intra-node-data-parallel-size <DP> --worker-urls http://<server>:<port>
-  ```
-
-  `consistent_hash` replaces the router's `cache_aware` default, `--request-timeout-secs`
-  raises its 1800 s default so long agentic requests finish, and `--disable-retries` stops the
-  router from replaying a failed request. Set `--intra-node-data-parallel-size` to the server's
-  `--data-parallel-size` (2 or 4). The benchmark also binds the router's Prometheus endpoint
-  to localhost; that is telemetry, not a serving setting.
-
-  In the command builder, pick **B200** and the **FP8 (0909)** checkpoint, and tick
-  **Speculative decoding** and **Text only** (both are opt-in). **Tensor Parallel** then
-  renders the TP2 c1 settings, and **Data + Expert Parallel** renders the DEP2 c24/c32 engine
-  settings. The builder's DEP spans all eight GPUs, so set `--data-parallel-size 2` (or 4 for
-  DEP4), select the matching GPUs, change the vLLM Router's `--intra-node-data-parallel-size`
-  to the same value, and take the per-concurrency values above.
-
-  ### Aggregate serving on B300
-
-  The B300 aggregate lanes in
-  [InferenceX #4332](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4332)
-  ([full config](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/ad96b211c783aece9914b332bff96842b2d9ae43/inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/dsv41flash/vllm/b300-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml))
-  serve the original
-  [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash checkpoint](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash)
-  on `vllm/vllm-openai:cu134-nightly-x86_64-dev-20261019-mk` with
-  `--kernel-config '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune":true}'` and `--max-model-len 1048576`.
-
-  | Lane | Concurrency | `--max-num-seqs` | `--max-num-batched-tokens` | `--prefill-schedule-interval` | Attention backend |
-  |---|---|---|---|---|---|
-  | TP4 | 1, 8, 16 | 1, 16, 32 | 4096, 8192, 8192 | 1, 160, 128 | `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41` |
-  | DEP2 | 8, 16, 32, 64 | 16, 16, 32, 64 | 16384, 16384, 16384, 32768 | 80, 80, 80, 56 | `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41` |
-  | DEP2 + KV offload | 128, 192 | 128, 192 | 16384 | 32 | `FLASHMLA_MEGA_ATTN_DSV41` |
-
-  TP4 uses `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true,"use_thp":true}'` and
-  `--additional-config '{"decode_backend":"latency_specialized"}'`. The specialized decode
-  comes from [#61868](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61868) and
-  [#61869](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61869), which are not yet on main,
-  and serves pure decode steps only, hence the long prefill interval at c8 and c16.
-  TP4 adds graph capture size 5, so the DSpark draft gets a one-request graph.
-
-  DEP2 (TP1 x DP2 with expert parallelism) runs behind a consistent-hash vLLM Router with
-  `--kernel-config '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune":true,"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe"}'`
-  and `--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true,"embedding_across_dp":true}'`. At c128 and
-  c192, KV blocks are offloaded lazily to DRAM, 50 GiB per DP rank, and are written only
-  when evicted from HBM:
-
-  ```
-  --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"SimpleCPUOffloadConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"cpu_bytes_to_use_per_rank":53687091200,"lazy_offload":true}}'
-  ```
+  The lanes served the 0909 launch checkpoint, **FP8 (0909)**. The DEP presets use two or
+  four of the node's GPUs, so run one server per GPU group, each behind its own vLLM Router.

     --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"thinking": true}'
 ```
 
+### Mapping Reasoning Efforts
+
+Chat templates differ in which `reasoning_effort` values they recognize, and some silently fall back to another effort (e.g. maximum reasoning) for values they do not know. Use `--reasoning-effort-map` to rewrite the efforts clients send into ones the template supports. For a template that only recognizes `low`, `high` and `max`:
+
+```bash
+vllm serve <model> \
+    --reasoning-effort-map '{"minimal": "low", "medium": "low", "xhigh": "max"}'
+```
+
+The map applies to the effort set through the Chat Completions (`reasoning_effort`), Responses (`reasoning.effort`) and Anthropic Messages (`output_config.effort`) APIs. Efforts that are not listed pass through unchanged, and a `reasoning_effort` set directly in `chat_template_kwargs` is not rewritten. Keys must be one of `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`; values are passed to the chat template as-is. Mapping an effort to `none` disables thinking for templates that honor `enable_thinking`.
+
 ### Request-Level Override
 
 Request-level `chat_template_kwargs` always take priority over server defaults. For example, if the server is started with `enable_thinking=false`, a client can still enable it for a specific request:

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Run the configured drafter with fixed, fully accepted target results."""
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.dp_utils import DPSyncState
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.utils import get_drafter_hidden_states
+from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import use_workspace_lane
+
+
+class DraftBench:
+    def __init__(self, runner):
+        self.runner = runner
+        self.speculator = runner.speculator
+        self.method = runner.vllm_config.speculative_config.method
+        if self.method not in ("mtp", "eagle", "eagle3", "dspark", "dflash"):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Drafter timing does not support {self.method!r}; "
+                "use --exclude-drafter for target-only timing."
+            )
+
+    def prepare(self, input_batch, context):
+        runner = self.runner
+        self.batch = (
+            runner.pcp_manager.global_batch if runner.pcp_manager else input_batch
+        )
+        self.context = context
+        drafts = self.batch.num_draft_tokens_per_req
+        accepted = (
+            np.ones(self.batch.num_reqs, dtype=np.int32)
+            if drafts is None
+            else drafts.astype(np.int32) + 1
+        )
+        self.num_sampled = torch.tensor(accepted, device=runner.device)
+        self.num_rejected = torch.zeros_like(self.num_sampled)
+        # Fixed valid bonus token: target logits and rejection sampling are not timed.
+        self.last_sampled = torch.zeros_like(runner.req_states.last_sampled_tokens)
+        self.dp_sync_state = (
+            DPSyncState(
+                num_tokens_across_dp=torch.full(
+                    (runner.dp_size,),
+                    input_batch.num_tokens_after_padding,
+                    dtype=torch.int32,
+                ),
+                uniform_token_count=None,
+                eager=True,
+                num_reqs=self.batch.num_reqs,
+            )
+            if runner.dp_size > 1
+            else None
+        )
+
+    def propose(self, output):
+        runner = self.runner
+        if runner.use_aux_hidden_state_outputs:
+            hidden, aux = output
+        else:
+            hidden, aux = output, None
+        draft_hidden = get_drafter_hidden_states(runner.model, hidden)
+        if runner.pcp_manager is not None and aux is not None:
+            aux = [runner.pcp_manager.restore_hidden_states(states) for states in aux]
+        with use_workspace_lane(runner._draft_workspace_lane):
+            self.tokens = self.speculator.propose(
+                self.batch,
+                self.context.attn_metadata,
+                self.context.slot_mapping,
+                draft_hidden,
+                aux,
+                self.num_sampled,
+                self.num_rejected,
+                self.last_sampled,
+                runner.req_states.next_prefill_tokens,
+                runner.sampler.sampling_states.temperature.gpu,
+                runner.sampler.sampling_states.seeds.gpu,
+                dp_sync_state=self.dp_sync_state,
+                num_speculative_tokens=runner.num_speculative_steps,
+            )
+
+    def check(self, reference):
+        return {
+            "method": self.method,
+            "acceptance": "all",
+            "num_draft_tokens": self.runner.num_speculative_steps,
+            "output_shape": list(self.tokens.shape),
+            "graph_matches_eager": bool(torch.equal(self.tokens, reference)),
+            "valid_token_ids": bool(
+                (
+                    (self.tokens >= 0)
+                    & (self.tokens < self.runner.model_config.get_vocab_size())
+                ).all()
+            ),
+        }

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Torch version checks.
+
+Kept free of other vLLM imports so that early importers such as
+`vllm.env_override` don't pull in `vllm.utils.torch_utils`, which resolves
+`current_platform` at import time.
+"""
+
+import importlib.metadata
+
+import torch
+from packaging import version
+from packaging.version import Version
+
+
+# Helper function used in testing.
+def _is_torch_equal_or_newer(torch_version: str, target: str) -> bool:
+    return version.parse(torch_version) >= version.parse(target)
+
+
+def is_torch_equal_or_newer(target: str) -> bool:
+    """Check if the installed torch version is >= the target version
+    (a string like "2.6.0").
+    """
+    try:
+        return _is_torch_equal_or_newer(str(torch.__version__), target)
+    except Exception:
+        # Fallback to PKG-INFO to load the package info, needed by the doc gen.
+        return Version(importlib.metadata.version("torch")) >= Version(target)
+
+
+def _is_torch_equal(target: str) -> bool:
+    assert target.count(".") == 2
+    torch_version = str(torch.__version__)
+    torch_version = version.parse(torch_version)
+    # torch version is like "2.6.0.dev20240101" or "2.6.0.dev20240101+cpu"
+    # or "2.6.0+cu128" but never "2.6.0.1"
+    return (
+        torch_version >= version.parse(target)
+        and version.parse(target + ".1") > torch_version
+    )
+
+
+def is_torch_equal(target: str) -> bool:
+    """Check if the installed torch version is == the target version
+    (a string like "2.6.0").
+    """
+    try:
+        return _is_torch_equal(target)
+    except Exception:
+        return Version(importlib.metadata.version("torch")) == Version(target)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Shared helpers for the MuseSpark1x MoE runner tests."""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.config import (
+    KernelConfig,
+    ParallelConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+    set_current_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import FusedMoEFactory
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.modelopt import ModelOptNvFp4Config
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.muse_moe_runner import (
+    MuseMoERunner,
+    MusePostExpertFinalize,
+    MuseSpark1xRouter,
+    MuseSparkRoutedExperts,
+)
+
+# route_scale must be 1.0 and scoring sigmoid for the routing to classify as
+# MiniMax2, which is what lets the monolithic kernel run MuseSpark's router.
+ROUTE_SCALE = 1.0
+DIVISION_EPS = 1e-15
+
+
+def nvfp4_quant_config() -> ModelOptNvFp4Config:
+    return ModelOptNvFp4Config(
+        quant_method="NVFP4",
+        is_checkpoint_nvfp4_serialized=True,
+        kv_cache_quant_algo=None,
+        exclude_modules=[],
+        group_size=16,
+    )
+
+
+def make_runner(
+    norm: torch.nn.Module,
+    expert_bias: torch.Tensor,
+    ckpt: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+    quant_config=None,
+    *,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    intermediate_size: int,
+    top_k: int,
+):
+    """Build a MuseSpark runner, load ``ckpt`` and finalize its weights."""
+    num_experts = expert_bias.numel()
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),
+        kernel_config=KernelConfig(moe_backend="auto"),
+    )
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config):
+        router = MuseSpark1xRouter(
+            top_k=top_k,
+            num_experts=num_experts,
+            expert_bias=expert_bias,
+            route_scale=ROUTE_SCALE,
+            router_score_normalization="sigmoid",
+            router_score_division_eps=DIVISION_EPS,
+        )
+        runner = FusedMoEFactory(
+            num_experts=num_experts,
+            top_k=top_k,
+            hidden_size=hidden_size,
+            intermediate_size=intermediate_size,
+            renormalize=True,
+            router=router,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix="moe.experts",
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            scoring_func="sigmoid",
+            e_score_correction_bias=expert_bias,
+            routed_scaling_factor=ROUTE_SCALE,
+            routed_experts_cls=MuseSparkRoutedExperts,
+            runner_cls=MuseMoERunner,
+            runner_args={"post_expert_norm": norm},
+        )
+    runner.cuda()
+    routed = runner.routed_experts
+    loaded = list(routed.load_weights(list(ckpt.items())))
+    assert len(loaded) == len(ckpt)
+    routed.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(routed)
+    moe_kernel = routed.quant_method.moe_kernel
+    assert moe_kernel is not None
+    experts = moe_kernel.fused_experts
+    assert experts.post_gemm2_hook is runner.post_expert_finalize
+    assert isinstance(runner.post_expert_finalize, MusePostExpertFinalize)
+    assert not runner.post_expert_finalize.pre_norm_all_reduce
+    return router, runner, vllm_config
+
+
+def run_moe(runner, vllm_config, x, logits):
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config), set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+        return runner.forward(hidden_states=x, router_logits=logits)
+
+
+def assert_cudagraph_replays(runner, vllm_config, x, logits, next_x, next_logits):
+    """A captured forward replayed on new inputs matches an eager forward."""
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config), set_forward_context(None, vllm_config):
+        # FlashInfer autotuning must happen before capture.
+        for _ in range(3):
+            runner.forward(hidden_states=x, router_logits=logits)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+        x_static, logits_static = x.clone(), logits.clone()
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            out_static = runner.forward(
+                hidden_states=x_static, router_logits=logits_static
+            )
+
+        expected = runner.forward(
+            hidden_states=next_x, router_logits=next_logits
+        ).clone()
+        x_static.copy_(next_x)
+        logits_static.copy_(next_logits)
+        graph.replay()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out_static, expected)
+
+
+def swiglu_moe_ref(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    w13: torch.Tensor,
+    w2: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_fn: Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor],
+    act_quant: Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """fp32 SwiGLU MoE with ``norm_fn`` applied to each BF16 expert output."""
+    out = torch.zeros(x.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    for e in range(w13.shape[0]):
+        token_idx, slot = (topk_ids == e).nonzero(as_tuple=True)
+        if token_idx.numel() == 0:
+            continue
+        gate, up = (x[token_idx].float() @ w13[e].float().t()).chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        inter = F.silu(gate) * up
+        if act_quant is not None:
+            inter = act_quant(inter)
+        y = norm_fn((inter @ w2[e].float().t()).to(torch.bfloat16)).float()
+        out.index_add_(0, token_idx, y * topk_weights[token_idx, slot, None])
+    return out

+    pytest.skip("Requires an SM90 GPU with Marlin", allow_module_level=True)

+E, N, K, TOPK, M = 8, 256, 512, 2, 8
+
+
+def _build(checkpoint: dict[str, torch.Tensor], quant_config=None):
+    norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale(
+        K,
+        eps=1e-8,
+        has_weight=True,
+        is_post_norm=True,
+        zero_centered_gamma=True,
+    ).cuda()
+    norm.weight.copy_(torch.linspace(-0.2, 0.2, K, device="cuda"))
+    expert_bias = torch.linspace(-0.5, 0.5, E, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    router, runner, vllm_config = make_runner(
+        norm,
+        expert_bias,
+        checkpoint,
+        quant_config,
+        hidden_size=K,
+        intermediate_size=N,
+        top_k=TOPK,
+    )
+    experts = runner.routed_experts.quant_method.moe_kernel.fused_experts
+    return router, norm, runner, vllm_config, experts
+
+
+def _nvfp4_checkpoint() -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+
+    def packed(*shape):
+        return torch.randint(
+            0, 256, shape, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda", generator=g
+        )
+
+    def rand(*shape):
+        return torch.rand(*shape, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda", generator=g)
+
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": packed(E, 2 * N, K // 2),
+        "w13_weight_scale": torch.ones(
+            E, 2 * N, K // 16, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device="cuda"
+        ),
+        "w13_weight_scale_2": rand(E, 2) * 0.01 + 0.01,
+        "w13_input_scale": rand(E, 2) + 0.5,
+        "w2_weight": packed(E, K, N // 2),
+        "w2_weight_scale": torch.ones(
+            E, K, N // 16, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device="cuda"
+        ),
+        "w2_weight_scale_2": rand(E) * 0.01 + 0.01,
+        "w2_input_scale": rand(E) + 0.5,
+    }
+
+
+def _dequant(q, scale, global_scale):
+    return dequantize_to_dtype(
+        q, scale, global_scale, torch.bfloat16, block_size=16, swizzle=False
+    )
+
+
+def _expected(router, norm, hidden_states, router_logits, w13, w2):
+    topk_weights, topk_ids = router._compute_routing(hidden_states, router_logits, None)
+    return swiglu_moe_ref(
+        hidden_states,
+        w13,
+        w2,
+        topk_weights,
+        topk_ids,
+        lambda y: norm.forward_native(y, out_dtype=torch.float32),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("down_scale", [1.0, 1e-4])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_hopper_marlin_moe_runs_with_triton_finalize(

+    checkpoint = _nvfp4_checkpoint()

+    )
+    assert type(experts) is MarlinExperts
+    assert experts.g1_alphas is not None
+    assert experts.g1_alphas.shape == (E,)
+
+    hidden_states = torch.randn(M, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda") / 10
+    router_logits = torch.randn(M, E, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    output = run_moe(runner, vllm_config, hidden_states, router_logits)
+    assert output.shape == hidden_states.shape
+    assert output.dtype == hidden_states.dtype
+    assert torch.isfinite(output).all()
+
+    w13 = torch.empty(E, 2 * N, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    for expert in range(E):
+        for shard, rows in ((0, slice(0, N)), (1, slice(N, 2 * N))):
+            w13[expert, rows] = _dequant(
+                checkpoint["w13_weight"][expert, rows],
+                checkpoint["w13_weight_scale"][expert, rows],
+                checkpoint["w13_weight_scale_2"][expert, shard],
+            )
+    w2 = _dequant(
+        checkpoint["w2_weight"],
+        checkpoint["w2_weight_scale"],
+        checkpoint["w2_weight_scale_2"],
+    )
+    expected = _expected(router, norm, hidden_states, router_logits, w13, w2)

+    assert_cudagraph_replays(
+        runner,
+        vllm_config,
+        hidden_states,
+        router_logits,

+    dp_size: int = 1,
+    sp_size: int = 1,
+    enable_eplb: bool = False,
+    routing_method: RoutingMethodType = RoutingMethodType.MiniMax2,
+    skip_final_all_reduce: bool = False,
+) -> FusedMoEConfig:
+    parallel_config = FusedMoEParallelConfig(
+        tp_size=tp_size,
+        pcp_size=1,
+        dp_size=dp_size,
+        ep_size=ep_size,
+        tp_rank=0,
+        pcp_rank=0,
+        dp_rank=0,
+        ep_rank=0,
+        sp_size=sp_size,
+        use_ep=ep_size > 1,
+        all2all_backend="allgather_reducescatter",
+        enable_eplb=enable_eplb,
+    )
+    return FusedMoEConfig(
+        num_experts=32,
+        experts_per_token=8,
+        hidden_dim=2048,
+        intermediate_size=1024,
+        num_local_experts=32 // ep_size,
+        num_logical_experts=32,
+        moe_parallel_config=parallel_config,
+        in_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        max_num_tokens=64,
+        activation=MoEActivation.SILU,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        routing_method=routing_method,
+        skip_final_all_reduce=skip_final_all_reduce,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "kwargs,expect_pre",
+    [
+        # TP shards the intermediate dim, so GEMM2 rows are partial sums and
+        # must be summed *before* the row-wise norm.
+        ({"tp_size": 8}, True),
+        # EP leaves every expert whole on its owning rank, so the ranks hold
+        # disjoint addends, summed after the norm by the runner's all-reduce...
+        ({"ep_size": 8}, False),
+        # ...or, with DP+EP, by the prepare/finalize combine.
+        ({"ep_size": 8, "dp_size": 2, "sp_size": 4}, False),
+        ({"ep_size": 8, "dp_size": 2}, False),
+        ({}, False),
+    ],
+)

+    """The finalizer's only collective is the pre-norm TP all-reduce.
+
+    Under EP, DP ranks call it with different token counts, so any other
+    collective would hang.
+    """
+    config = _moe_config(**kwargs)
+    validate_deployment(config, kernel_routes=True)
+    assert needs_pre_norm_all_reduce(config) is expect_pre
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "kwargs,reason",
+    [
+        ({"routing_method": RoutingMethodType.Unspecified}, "MiniMax2"),
+        ({"routing_method": RoutingMethodType.DeepSeekV3}, "MiniMax2"),
+        ({"enable_eplb": True}, "EPLB"),
+        # Sequence parallel without an all2all combine has nothing to fold
+        # the reduce-scatter into.
+        ({"tp_size": 8, "sp_size": 8}, "sequence-parallel"),
+        # The runner reduces inside, so an un-reduced output cannot be honored.
+        ({"tp_size": 8, "skip_final_all_reduce": True}, "un-reduced"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_unsupported_deployments_are_rejected(kwargs, reason):
+    """Unsupported deployments must raise, not skip the norm or miscount sums."""
+    with pytest.raises((NotImplementedError, ValueError), match=reason):
+        validate_deployment(_moe_config(**kwargs), kernel_routes=True)
+
+
+def test_routing_is_only_constrained_when_the_kernel_routes():
+    """Modular experts take topk_ids from MuseSpark1xRouter, so any routing works."""
+    config = _moe_config(routing_method=RoutingMethodType.Unspecified)
+    validate_deployment(config, kernel_routes=False)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "kwargs,match",
+    [
+        ({"tp_size": 8}, None),
+        ({"ep_size": 8}, None),
+        ({"dp_size": 2}, "DP1"),
+        ({"sp_size": 2}, "sequence-parallel"),
+        ({"enable_eplb": True}, "EPLB"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_hopper_route_major_deployments(kwargs, match):
+    if match is None:
+        _validate_route_major_deployment(_moe_config(**kwargs))
+        return
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match=match):
+        _validate_route_major_deployment(_moe_config(**kwargs))

+    """An EP rank that owns no expert in the batch must contribute exactly zero.
+
+    Its unwritten workspace holds arbitrary bits and ``NaN * 0`` is NaN, so
+    zero-weighting the rows is not enough.
+    """
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    topk = 8
+    num_tokens, rows_total = 5, 40
+    # Uniform bf16 bit patterns: ~0.4% are NaN/Inf, so a row this wide almost
+    # surely holds one.
+    gemm2_output = (
+        torch.randint(
+            0, 65536, (rows_total, hidden_dim), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
+        )
+        .to(torch.int16)
+        .view(dtype)
+    )
+    expert_weights = torch.randn((num_tokens, topk), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+    permuted_idx = torch.full((num_tokens, topk), -1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    rms_norm_weight = torch.randn(hidden_dim, device="cuda", dtype=dtype) * 0.1
+    output = torch.empty((num_tokens, hidden_dim), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+
+    moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm(
+        gemm2_output,
+        expert_weights,
+        permuted_idx,
+        rms_norm_weight,
+        output,
+        topk=topk,
+        eps=1e-6,
+        weight_before_norm=weight_before_norm,
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output, torch.zeros_like(output), rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+@requires_cutedsl_finalize
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("weight_before_norm", [False, True])
+def test_fp32_routing_weights_match_bf16(weight_before_norm: bool) -> None:

+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    hidden_dim, topk, rows = 4096, 8, 17
+    torch.manual_seed(0)

+    weights_fp32 = torch.rand((rows, topk), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    permuted_idx = torch.arange(rows * topk, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(
+        rows, topk
+    )
+    rms_norm_weight = torch.randn(hidden_dim, device="cuda", dtype=dtype) * 0.1
+
+    def run(weights: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        out = torch.empty((rows, hidden_dim), device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+        moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm(
+            gemm2_output,
+            weights,
+            permuted_idx,
+            rms_norm_weight,
+            out,
+            topk=topk,
+            eps=1e-6,
+            weight_before_norm=weight_before_norm,
+        )
+        return out
+
+    got = run(weights_fp32)

+    err_rounded = (rounded.float() - ref).abs().max().item()
+    # bf16 weights carry ~3 decimal digits, so rounding them is the larger error.

+def build_moe(norm_cls, ckpt: dict[str, torch.Tensor], quant_config=None):
+    # Non-zero so selecting on biased scores and normalizing unbiased ones is
+    # distinguishable from using one set for both.
+    expert_bias = (torch.rand(E, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32) - 0.5) * 0.4
+    norm = norm_cls(
+        hidden_size=K,
+        eps=1e-6,
+        has_weight=True,
+        is_post_norm=True,
+        zero_centered_gamma=True,
+    ).cuda()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        norm.weight.copy_(
+            torch.randn(K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32) * 0.1 - 0.2
+        )
+    router, runner, vllm_config = make_runner(
+        norm,
+        expert_bias,
+        ckpt,
+        quant_config,
+        hidden_size=K,
+        intermediate_size=N,
+        top_k=TOPK,
+    )
+    assert router.routing_method_type == RoutingMethodType.MiniMax2
+    routed = runner.routed_experts
+    assert routed.quant_method.is_monolithic
+    return router, routed, norm, vllm_config, runner
+
+
+def _inputs(seed: int):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    return (
+        torch.randn(M, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 10,
+        torch.randn(M, E, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32),

+
+def _bf16_checkpoint(seed: int = 0):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": torch.randn(E, 2 * N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        / 15,
+        "w2_weight": torch.randn(E, K, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 15,
+    }
+
+
+def _quant_side(w: torch.Tensor, global_scale: torch.Tensor):
+    """Quantize [rows, cols] to (packed fp4 uint8, linear fp8 block scales)."""
+    q, sf = ops.scaled_fp4_quant(
+        w.to(torch.bfloat16),
+        global_scale.to(torch.float32).reshape(1),
+        is_sf_swizzled_layout=False,
+    )
+    assert q.shape == (w.shape[0], w.shape[1] // 2)
+    assert sf.shape == (w.shape[0], w.shape[1] // 16)
+    return q, sf
+
+
+def _dequant(q, sf, gs):
+    return dequantize_nvfp4_to_dtype(
+        q,
+        sf,
+        gs,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+        device="cuda",
+        block_size=16,
+        is_sf_128x4_layout=False,
+        is_sf_linear_layout=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _nvfp4_checkpoint(seed: int = 0):
+    """A checkpoint-layout NVFP4 MoE layer with distinct w1/w3 scales."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    w13 = torch.randn(E, 2 * N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 15
+    w2 = torch.randn(E, K, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) / 15
+
+    # modelopt convention: dequant scale s = amax / (448 * 6), quantize with 1/s.
+    w13_s2 = torch.empty(E, 2, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    w13_q = torch.empty(E, 2 * N, K // 2, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    w13_sf = torch.empty(E, 2 * N, K // 16, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    for e in range(E):
+        for col, rows in ((0, w13[e, :N]), (1, w13[e, N:])):
+            jitter = 1.0 + 0.4 * torch.rand((), generator=g, device="cuda")
+            s = rows.abs().max() / FP4_SF_MAX * jitter
+            w13_s2[e, col] = s
+            q, sf = _quant_side(rows.float(), 1.0 / s)
+            w13_q[e, col * N : (col + 1) * N] = q
+            w13_sf[e, col * N : (col + 1) * N] = sf.view(torch.uint8)
+
+    w2_s2 = torch.empty(E, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    w2_q = torch.empty(E, K, N // 2, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    w2_sf = torch.empty(E, K, N // 16, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    for e in range(E):
+        s = w2[e].abs().max() / FP4_SF_MAX
+        w2_s2[e] = s
+        q, sf = _quant_side(w2[e].float(), 1.0 / s)
+        w2_q[e] = q
+        w2_sf[e] = sf.view(torch.uint8)
+
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": w13_q,
+        "w13_weight_scale": w13_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        "w13_weight_scale_2": w13_s2,
+        "w13_input_scale": torch.rand(E, 2, generator=g, device="cuda") + 0.5,
+        "w2_weight": w2_q,
+        "w2_weight_scale": w2_sf.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        "w2_weight_scale_2": w2_s2,
+        "w2_input_scale": torch.rand(E, generator=g, device="cuda") + 0.5,
+    }
+
+
+def _dequant_nvfp4_weights(ckpt: dict[str, torch.Tensor]):
+    w13 = torch.empty(E, 2 * N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    w2 = torch.empty(E, K, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    for e in range(E):
+        for col, sl in ((0, slice(0, N)), (1, slice(N, 2 * N))):
+            w13[e, sl] = _dequant(
+                ckpt["w13_weight"][e, sl],
+                ckpt["w13_weight_scale"][e, sl],
+                1.0 / ckpt["w13_weight_scale_2"][e, col],
+            )
+        w2[e] = _dequant(
+            ckpt["w2_weight"][e],
+            ckpt["w2_weight_scale"][e],
+            1.0 / ckpt["w2_weight_scale_2"][e],
+        )
+    return w13, w2
+
+
+def _rel(actual: torch.Tensor, expected: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    return ((actual.float() - expected).norm() / expected.norm()).item()

+def test_muse_spark_bf16_moe_kernel_router_matches_reference(dist_init, workspace_init):
+    """The fused router must select on biased scores but weight by unbiased ones."""
+    ckpt = _bf16_checkpoint(seed=3)
+    router, routed, _, vllm_config, runner = build_moe(MuseSpark1xRMSNorm, ckpt)
+
+    captured: list[UnfinalizedMoEOutput] = []
+    experts = routed.quant_method.moe_kernel.fused_experts
+    inner = experts.post_gemm2_hook
+
+    def _spy(unfinalized, out):
+        captured.append(unfinalized)
+        inner(unfinalized, out)
+
+    experts.post_gemm2_hook = _spy
+    try:
+        x, logits = _inputs(3)
+        run_moe(runner, vllm_config, x, logits)
+    finally:
+        experts.post_gemm2_hook = inner
+
+    # Otherwise the kernel did not defer and the norm was silently skipped.
+    assert len(captured) == 1
+    kernel_weights = captured[0].expert_weights.float()
+
+    scores = torch.sigmoid(logits.float())
+    biased = scores + router.expert_bias
+    ids = torch.topk(biased, TOPK, dim=-1).indices
+    unbiased_norm = torch.gather(scores, 1, ids)
+    unbiased_norm = unbiased_norm / (unbiased_norm.sum(-1, keepdim=True) + DIVISION_EPS)
+    biased_norm = torch.gather(biased, 1, ids)
+    biased_norm = biased_norm / (biased_norm.sum(-1, keepdim=True) + DIVISION_EPS)
+
+    got = kernel_weights.sort(dim=-1).values
+    want = unbiased_norm.sort(dim=-1).values
+    wrong = biased_norm.sort(dim=-1).values
+    assert (want - wrong).abs().max() > 1e-2
+    assert (got - want).abs().max() < 5e-3
+    assert (got - wrong).abs().max() > 5e-3
+

+def nanosleep(ns: int, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    nvvm.nanosleep(Int32(ns).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), loc=loc, ip=ip)

+@dsl_user_op
+def multimem_ld_reduce_16B(x: cute.Tensor, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> cute.Tensor:
+    # The vector instruction assumes x is contiguous and 16-byte aligned.
+    assert x.element_type == BFloat16
+    vec_type = ".v4.bf16x2"
+
+    ptr = x.iterator.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)
+    asm = (
+        "multimem.ld_reduce.relaxed.gpu.global.add.acc::f32"
+        f"{vec_type} {{$0, $1, $2, $3}}, [$4];"
+    )
+    struct = llvm.inline_asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([Int32.mlir_type] * 4),
+        [ptr],
+        asm,
+        "=r,=r,=r,=r,l",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    vec = vector.from_elements(
+        ir.VectorType.get([4], Int32.mlir_type, loc=loc),
+        [
+            llvm.extractvalue(Int32.mlir_type, struct, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip)
+            for i in range(4)
+        ],
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    ssa = cute.TensorSSA(vec, 4, Int32)
+
+    y = cute.make_rmem_tensor(4, Int32)
+    y.store(ssa)
+    return cute.recast_tensor(y, x.element_type)
+

+@dsl_user_op
+def multimem_st_16B(dst: cute.Tensor, value: cute.Tensor, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    # Assumes contiguous BF16x8 vectors and a 16-byte aligned dst.
+    assert dst.element_type == BFloat16
+    assert value.element_type == BFloat16
+    ptr = dst.iterator.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)
+    regs = cute.recast_tensor(value, Int32, loc=loc, ip=ip)
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [ptr] + [regs[i].ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for i in range(4)],
+        "multimem.st.relaxed.sys.global.v4.f32 [$0], {$1, $2, $3, $4};",
+        "l,r,r,r,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )

+"""MuseSpark1x routed experts on DeepGEMM BF16 and NVFP4 MegaMoE kernels.
+
+The ModelOpt NVFP4 checkpoint maps onto the kernel without requantization.
+"""
+
+import functools
+import inspect
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm import envs
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.distributed import (
+    get_ep_group,
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_rank,
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size,
+)
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.utils import set_weight_attrs
+from vllm.models.common.ops.sequence_parallel import is_sequence_parallel_active
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.ops.prepare_megamoe_bf16 import (
+    prepare_megamoe_bf16_inputs,
+)
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.ops.prepare_megamoe_nvfp4 import (
+    prepare_megamoe_nvfp4_inputs,
+)
+from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import _import_deep_gemm
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.nvidia.model import MuseSpark1xRMSNorm
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _get_deep_gemm():
+    module = _import_deep_gemm()
+    if (
+        module is None
+        or not hasattr(module, "fp4_fp4_mega_moe")
+        or not hasattr(module, "bf16_mega_moe")
+        or "post_expert_norm_gamma"
+        not in inspect.signature(module.bf16_mega_moe).parameters
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Muse Spark MegaMoE requires the pinned DeepGEMM build "
+            "with BF16 post-expert normalization. "
+            "Install it with tools/install_deepgemm.sh or rebuild the vLLM wheel."
+        )
+    return module
+
+
+def _shard_padding_mask(is_padding: torch.Tensor, num_tokens: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """This rank's chunk of a full-length padding mask; the round-up tail pads."""
+    tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+    tp_rank = get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
+    pad = num_tokens * tp_size - is_padding.shape[0]
+    if pad > 0:
+        is_padding = torch.nn.functional.pad(is_padding, (0, pad), value=True)
+    return is_padding.narrow(0, tp_rank * num_tokens, num_tokens)
+
+
+class MuseSparkMegaMoEExperts(nn.Module):
+    _symm_buffer_cache: dict[tuple, tuple] = {}
+
+    def __init__(

+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        *,
+        num_experts: int,
+        num_local_experts: int,
+        experts_start_idx: int,
+        top_k: int,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        intermediate_size: int,
+        post_expert_norm: "MuseSpark1xRMSNorm",
+        num_max_tokens_per_rank: int,
+        is_sequence_parallel: bool = False,
+        is_nvfp4: bool = True,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.prefix = prefix
+        self.num_experts = num_experts
+        self.num_local_experts = num_local_experts
+        self.experts_start_idx = experts_start_idx
+        self.experts_end_idx = experts_start_idx + num_local_experts
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.intermediate_size = intermediate_size
+        self.max_num_tokens = num_max_tokens_per_rank
+        self.is_sequence_parallel = is_sequence_parallel
+        self.post_expert_norm = post_expert_norm
+        self.is_nvfp4 = is_nvfp4
+
+        if hidden_size % 256 != 0 or intermediate_size % 256 != 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MuseSpark1x MegaMoE requires hidden and intermediate "
+                "sizes to be multiples of 256 for its shared BF16/NVFP4 "
+                f"buffer layouts; got {hidden_size}/{intermediate_size}."
+            )
+
+        attrs = {"weight_loader": self.weight_loader}
+
+        def param(*shape: int, dtype: torch.dtype) -> nn.Parameter:
+            p = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(shape, dtype=dtype), requires_grad=False)
+            set_weight_attrs(p, attrs)
+            return p
+
+        if is_nvfp4:
+            e4m3 = torch.float8_e4m3fn

+                num_local_experts,
+                2 * intermediate_size,
+                hidden_size // 2,
+                dtype=torch.uint8,
+            )
+            self.w13_weight_scale = param(
+                num_local_experts, 2 * intermediate_size, hidden_size // 16, dtype=e4m3
+            )
+            self.w13_weight_scale_2 = param(num_local_experts, 2, dtype=torch.float32)
+            self.w2_weight = param(
+                num_local_experts,
+                hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size // 2,
+                dtype=torch.uint8,
+            )
+            self.w2_weight_scale = param(
+                num_local_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size // 16, dtype=e4m3
+            )
+            self.w2_weight_scale_2 = param(num_local_experts, dtype=torch.float32)
+            self.w2_input_scale = param(num_local_experts, dtype=torch.float32)
+            self.w13_input_scale = param(num_local_experts, 2, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+        else:
+            self.w13_weight = param(
+                num_local_experts,
+                2 * intermediate_size,
+                hidden_size,
+                dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            )
+            self.w2_weight = param(
+                num_local_experts,
+                hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size,
+                dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            )
+
+        self._transformed_l1: (
+            torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None
+        ) = None
+        self._transformed_l2: (
+            torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None
+        ) = None
+        self._norm_gamma: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+        compilation_config = vllm_config.compilation_config
+        if prefix in compilation_config.static_forward_context:
+            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate layer name: {prefix}")
+        compilation_config.static_forward_context[prefix] = self
+
+    def weight_loader(
+        self,
+        param: nn.Parameter,
+        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        weight_name: str,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> None:
+        shard = loaded_weight[self.experts_start_idx : self.experts_end_idx]
+        if shard.shape != param.data.shape:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: expert weight {weight_name!r} shard "
+                f"{tuple(shard.shape)} does not fit parameter "
+                f"{tuple(param.data.shape)}"
+            )
+        param.data.copy_(shard.to(param.data.dtype))
+
+    def load_weights(
+        self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]
+    ) -> Iterable[str]:
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            param = getattr(self, name, None)
+            if param is None:
+                raise AttributeError(
+                    f"{self.prefix}: unexpected expert weight {name!r}"
+                )
+            self.weight_loader(param, tensor, name)
+            yield name
+
+    def finalize_weights(self) -> None:
+        """Repack checkpoint tensors into the layout the kernel reads."""
+        if self._transformed_l1 is not None:
+            return
+        deep_gemm = _get_deep_gemm()
+
+        if self.is_nvfp4:
+
+            def sf_to_kernel_layout(sf: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+                # Four E4M3 block scales per int32, then MN-major for the TMA loads.
+                packed = sf.data.view(torch.uint8).contiguous().view(torch.int32)
+                return packed.transpose(-1, -2).contiguous().transpose(-1, -2)
+
+            self._transformed_l1, self._transformed_l2 = (
+                deep_gemm.transform_weights_for_mega_moe(
+                    (
+                        self.w13_weight.data.view(torch.int8),
+                        sf_to_kernel_layout(self.w13_weight_scale),
+                    ),
+                    (
+                        self.w2_weight.data.view(torch.int8),
+                        sf_to_kernel_layout(self.w2_weight_scale),
+                    ),
+                )
+            )
+            self._drop_retransformed_weights()
+        else:
+            self._transformed_l1, self._transformed_l2 = (
+                deep_gemm.transform_weights_for_mega_moe(
+                    self.w13_weight.data, self.w2_weight.data
+                )
+            )
+            self.w13_weight = None

+        norm = self.post_expert_norm
+        gamma = norm.weight.data.float()
+        if norm.zero_centered_gamma:
+            gamma = gamma + norm.gain_center
+        self._norm_gamma = gamma.contiguous()
+
+    def _drop_retransformed_weights(self) -> None:
+        """Release the checkpoint tensors the kernel no longer reads."""
+        assert isinstance(self._transformed_l2, tuple)
+        kept = self._transformed_l2[0].untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+        if kept != self.w2_weight.untyped_storage().data_ptr():
+            raise AssertionError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: MegaMoE no longer returns the L2 weight "
+                "aliased to w2_weight, so the drop list here is stale."
+            )
+        for name in ("w13_weight", "w13_weight_scale", "w2_weight_scale"):
+            param = getattr(self, name)
+            if param.untyped_storage().data_ptr() == kept:
+                raise AssertionError(
+                    f"{self.prefix}: {name} is aliased by the transformed "
+                    "weights and must not be dropped."
+                )
+            setattr(self, name, None)
+
+    def get_symm_buffer(self):
+        """Return this dtype's view of the EP group's shared allocation.
+
+        Layers must consume the buffer sequentially; producers on auxiliary
+        streams must wait for the preceding layer before writing either view.
+        """
+        group = get_ep_group().device_group
+        key = (
+            id(group),
+            torch.accelerator.current_device_index(),
+            self.num_experts,
+            self.max_num_tokens,
+            self.top_k,
+            self.hidden_size,
+            self.intermediate_size,
+        )
+        buffers = self._symm_buffer_cache.get(key)
+        if buffers is None:
+            deep_gemm = _get_deep_gemm()
+            # BF16 needs the larger layout, so it owns the shared storage.
+            bf16 = deep_gemm.SymmBuffer(
+                group,
+                self.num_experts,
+                self.max_num_tokens,
+                self.top_k,
+                self.hidden_size,
+                self.intermediate_size,
+                mma_type="bf16xbf16",
+            )
+            nvfp4 = deep_gemm.SymmBuffer(
+                group,
+                self.num_experts,
+                self.max_num_tokens,
+                self.top_k,
+                self.hidden_size,
+                self.intermediate_size,
+                mma_type="fp4xfp4",
+                base=bf16,
+            )
+            buffers = (bf16, nvfp4)
+            self._symm_buffer_cache[key] = buffers
+        return buffers[1 if self.is_nvfp4 else 0]
+
+    def get_padding_mask(self, num_tokens: int) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        if not envs.VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING or not is_forward_context_available():
+            return None
+        is_padding = get_forward_context().is_padding
+        if is_padding is None:
+            return None

+                has_weight=True,
+                is_post_norm=True,

+                residual_id=None,

+            renormalize=True,

+            quant_config=quant_config,
